Pass languages to pageMetadata() on EN home and EN /blog

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: http:// and www. both resolve to canonical host, no redirect chains
nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all set
robots.txt valid with Host + 2 sitemaps; blocks only /admin and /api/
0 noindex pages, 0 non-200s, 0 orphans across 94 URLs
Edge cached (x-nextjs-cache: HIT) behind Caddy, HTTP/3 advertised

findings.title: Russian pages declare English as their language
findings.description: All 25 /ru* URLs serve <html lang="en">. app/layout.tsx:66 hardcodes lang="en" in the single root layout, so the /ru subtree inherits it.
findings.recommendation: Add app/ru/layout.tsx setting lang="ru", or restructure to an app/[locale]/ segment.

findings.title: hreflang non-reciprocal on / and /blog
findings.description: Verified: /ru emits en/ru/x-default alternates pointing at /; / emits no rel=alternate hreflang at all. Same for /blog vs /ru/blog. The 12 blog posts are correct. The sitemap declares xhtml:link alternates for the home URL, conflicting with page markup.
findings.recommendation: Pass languages:{en:'/',ru:'/ru'} to pageMetadata() in app/page.tsx and {en:'/blog',ru:'/ru/blog'} in app/blog/page.tsx.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: All other security headers present; CSP is the only gap on a privacy-branded site.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP header in next.config.mjs or Caddy.

findings.title: x-powered-by: Next.js exposed
findings.description: Response header discloses the framework.
findings.recommendation: Set poweredByHeader: false in next.config.mjs.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Publish /llms.txt. Ignored by Google Search, read by some AI crawlers.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 12 long-form blog posts at 1162-1515 words (6 EN + 6 RU)

findings.title: 63 of 94 pages under 300 words
findings.description: Site median 175 words. By section: blog tags ~70w (31 pages), glossary 142w (9), alternatives 183w (9), guides 262w (11). The commercial-intent sections are the thinnest non-tag content; /alternatives/whatsapp is 170 words.
findings.recommendation: Take /alternatives/* and /guides/* to 600+ words with comparison tables, who-should-switch sections, and FAQ blocks.

findings.title: 31 near-empty tag archives are indexable
findings.description: /blog/tag/* and /ru/blog/tag/* average ~65 words listing 1-2 posts. Nine EN tags are semantic duplicates (serverless / serverless-messaging / serverless-messenger; private-messenger / private-messaging / encrypted-messenger / encrypted-chat). All are in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: noindex,follow the tag archives and remove from sitemap, or consolidate to ~6 tags with real intro copy.

findings.title: Head-term cannibalization
findings.description: /best-private-messaging-apps (786w), /blog/best-private-messenger-2026 (1515w) and /guides/most-private-messaging-app-2026 (273w) target the same query. Title-overlap also flags /blog/privamesh-vs-{simplex,whatsapp,threema} against /alternatives/{simplex,whatsapp,threema}, and / against /privacy (Jaccard 0.60).
findings.recommendation: Designate one canonical target per cluster; convert the rest to supporting pages that link up.

findings.title: /news is an empty shell
findings.description: 26 words, 4 H2s, no items — indexed and in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Populate it or remove it from the index.

findings.title: Weak sitewide E-E-A-T surface
findings.description: /about is 353 words with no named team or external corroboration. Only 2 external domains linked sitewide: github.com (381 links), x.com (95).
findings.recommendation: Add named authors with credentials, cite the cryptographic specifications claimed (X3DH, Double Ratchet, BIP-39), link third-party coverage.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 2191 unique internal link edges, 0 orphan pages

findings.title: 30 titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: Worst: /ru/blog/privamesh-vs-simplex (80), /ru/blog/why-a-messenger-with-servers-can-never-be-fully-private (78), /blog/privamesh-vs-threema (73), /glossary/end-to-end-encryption (72). The '%s · PrivaMesh' template at app/layout.tsx:29 adds 12 chars.
findings.recommendation: Drop the suffix on routes whose own title already exceeds ~48 chars.

findings.title: Grammar error in glossary title template
findings.description: 'What is a End-to-end encryption (E2EE)?', 'What is a Metadata (in messaging)?' — hardcoded article breaks agreement.
findings.recommendation: Drop the article or make it agree with the term.

findings.title: 6 pages render duplicate H1s
findings.description: Identical H1 text twice on /blog/best-private-messenger-2026, /blog/privamesh-vs-threema, /blog/privamesh-vs-simplex and their RU counterparts.
findings.recommendation: Remove either the page-header component H1 or the MDX '#' heading.

findings.title: 12 commercial pages have only 1 inbound internal link
findings.description: All 10 /guides/* plus /alternatives/imessage and /alternatives/wickr are reachable only from their hub. 41 pages sit at <=2 inbound, 29 of them tag pages.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual cross-links from blog posts and comparison pages.

findings.title: 3 meta descriptions over 160 chars
findings.description: /terms (162), /best-private-messaging-apps (164), /ru/blog/why-a-messenger-with-servers-can-never-be-fully-private (174).
findings.recommendation: Trim to 150-160.

findings.title: 6 RU tag descriptions under 70 chars
findings.description: All built from the same 'Статьи про {tag} - ...' template.
findings.recommendation: Moot if tag pages are de-indexed; otherwise write per-tag copy.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: ItemList on 42, FAQPage on 14, Article+Person on 12, DefinedTerm on 8

findings.title: FAQPage on only 14 of 94 pages
findings.description: Absent from all 5 /features/*, 11 /guides/*, 9 /alternatives/*, 3 /compare/* — exactly the pages that earn AI Overview and PAA placement.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4-5 question FAQ block with FAQPage schema to each money page.

findings.title: 2 pages missing BreadcrumbList
findings.description: 92 of 94 have it.
findings.recommendation: Extend to the 2 remaining pages.

findings.title: SoftwareApplication on only 2 pages
findings.description: The app entity should appear on the home page and every feature page.
findings.recommendation: Emit SoftwareApplication sitewide on product pages.

findings.title: DefinedTerm present without DefinedTermSet
findings.description: 8 glossary entries are not linked into one vocabulary.
findings.recommendation: Add a DefinedTermSet for /glossary.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Full-page edge caching: x-nextjs-cache HIT, s-maxage=31536000, stale-while-revalidate

findings.title: Home page HTML is 156KB
findings.description: Nearly 3x the site median and the slowest response (280ms). It also carries NetworkBackground, an animated canvas that commit 32440a1 made run continuously during scroll — the most likely INP/CLS risk on the site.
findings.recommendation: Measure INP on the home page; consider pausing the canvas off-viewport or reducing initial payload.

findings.title: No field or lab CWV data collected
findings.description: No Chrome or Playwright browsers installed, so no Lighthouse run. LCP, INP and CLS are unmeasured; this score is inferred from payload and TTFB only.
findings.recommendation: Install Chrome, then run Lighthouse and connect CrUX/GSC for field data.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and bingbot all return 200
Bing msvalidate.01 token wired in, so the Copilot/DuckDuckGo path is live
14 FAQPage blocks and 8 DefinedTerm entries give directly citable passages
Six vs-competitor comparison pages match how users prompt LLMs

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Publish one listing the key pages and their purpose.

findings.title: Thin passages limit citability
findings.description: LLMs cite self-contained passages; 63 pages lack the substance to form one.
findings.recommendation: Address alongside the content-depth work.

findings.title: Almost no external corroboration
findings.description: Only github.com and x.com are linked sitewide. No citations to the cryptographic primitives claimed, no third-party coverage, no audit references — weak grounding for a 'trust math, not companies' positioning.
findings.recommendation: Cite specifications and independent sources on the technical pages.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 211 img elements, 0 missing alt, 0 empty alt
0 images missing width/height — CLS from images structurally prevented
Image sitemap with descriptive image:title and image:caption per screenshot

findings.title: 70 of 94 pages have no og:image
findings.description: All 94 pages declare twitter:card=summary_large_image. Verified on /features/no-servers: og:title, og:description, og:url and twitter:card present, no og:image or twitter:image. Next's opengraph-image.tsx exists at only 5 segments (app/, blog/[slug], compare/[slug], alternatives/[slug], ru/blog/[slug]) and does not cascade to siblings, so /features/*, /guides/*, /glossary/*, /blog/tag/*, /about, /news, /privacy, /terms and both blog indexes ship cardless.
findings.recommendation: Add segment-level opengraph-image.tsx, or set a default openGraph.images in lib/seo.ts so no route can ship without one.

findings.title: 5 images have no loading attribute
findings.description: Of 211 total.
findings.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" to below-fold images.

items: Install Python 3.10+ and Chrome to unblock the claude-seo toolchain
Measure Core Web Vitals on the 156KB home page with its canvas animation
Connect Google Search Console and GA4
Add a Content-Security-Policy header and set poweredByHeader: false
Establish a monthly drift baseline

limitations: claude-seo helper scripts require Python >=3.10; this machine has 3.9.6 with no Homebrew. Audit performed inline with curl and a custom Node crawler.
No Chrome or Playwright browsers: no Lighthouse, no Core Web Vitals, no screenshots.
No PDF report — google_report.py shares the Python 3.10 requirement.
No Google (CrUX/GSC/GA4), DataForSEO, Moz or Bing Webmaster credentials detected: no indexation, ranking, traffic or backlink data.
